Host load, clock accounting, GPU telemetry variation and audio overflow caveats remain required; current-build lifecycle/output is unqualified until its separate gate.

lifecycle.claim: Two real current-build snapshot/restore/resim windows per actual DEBUG_OFF production choice/game, clean warm/cold comparisons and resumed progress. Native synchronized GPU/VRAM output witnesses are compared at matched boundaries.
caveats: Tomba baseline/use each retain the same aux1/8 live-vs-restore drift per window; this is a shared pre-existing caveat, not a new PGO defect or proof of broad netplay compatibility.
Native VRAM readback/GPU wire equality does not prove every high-resolution presentation pixel, all gameplay, physical audio or controller behavior. Owner-end combined adoption remains outstanding.

Selfcheck instrumentation and snapshot readback are correctness-only; no timing gain is inferred. Earlier production audio-overflow and host-exposure caveats remain in the separate performance records.
